After opening at $2,270, the price dipped slightly to $2,265, then rebounded to $2,270, and most recently closed at $2,268. On the daily timeframe, Ethereum was also affected by the Binance security incident in October, but its losses were relatively modest. This was mainly due to two supporting factors: first, more than 1.23 million ETH (worth approximately $2.8 billion) entered the validator entry queue, significantly tightening circulating supply; second, major exchanges quickly confirmed that ETH reserves were fully backed on a 1:1 basis, effectively containing the spread of panic.

一、以太坊市场深度分析：质押锁仓与机构赎回的角力场

2026年11月1日，以太坊市场在复杂的地缘政治和安全事件背景下展现出独特的韧性。ETH当前报价2268美元，24小时内上涨约1.09%，表现略优于比特币。这一走势的背后，是创纪录的质押锁仓量与持续的现货ETF赎回之间的深层博弈。

二、价格走势分析

从小时K线观察，ETH在过去五个交易时段内围绕2265至2274美元区间窄幅整理。价格从2270美元开盘后小幅回落至2265美元，随后反弹至2270美元，最新收于2268美元。整体波动幅度极为有限，显示市场在当前位置处于多空均衡状态。

成交量方面，最近一个小时录得2358个ETH，折合约535万美元，较此前时段有所放大。这种温和放量配合价格横盘的格局，通常预示着即将出现方向性突破。

日线维度来看，以太坊在十月份同样受到了币安安全事件的冲击，但跌幅相对温和。这主要得益于两个支撑因素：一是超过123万枚ETH（价值约28亿美元）进入验证者入场队列，大幅收紧了流通供应；二是主要交易所迅速确认了ETH储备的1:1全额 backing，有效遏制了恐慌蔓延。

三、技术指标解读

均线系统显示，7周期均线报2267美元，25周期均线报2255美元，短期均线位于长期均线上方，形成温和的多头排列。但99周期均线仍在2284美元的高位，价格距离长期均线约0.7%的差距，说明中期下行趋势尚未完全修复。

MACD指标维持正值但动能有所衰减。MACD线报5.36，信号线报3.91，柱状图为1.45。虽然三线均为正值，但柱状图从此前的高点1.89收窄至1.45，暗示上涨动能正在边际减弱。

RSI指标方面，6周期RSI报65.84，12周期RSI报63.48，24周期RSI报54.05。短周期RSI从此前的高点72回落至65附近，超买压力有所释放。整体来看，ETH的RSI水平比BTC更为健康，短期回调风险相对可控。

布林带上轨报2272美元，中轨报2258美元，下轨报2243美元。当前价格2268美元接近上轨，但尚未触及，运行空间略优于BTC。KDJ指标中K值为68.32，D值为67.45，J值为70.05，三线粘合且处于中性偏强区域，没有明显的超买或超卖信号。

综合因子统计显示，15个技术因子中有6个做多、9个做空，空方占据明显优势。复合指标给出做空信号，历史胜率高达64.44%，这一信号值得重视。

四、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临一个独特的矛盾局面。一方面，链上质押活动异常活跃，超过123万枚ETH进入验证队列，流通可用性降至历史低位，这在结构上对价格形成强力支撑。另一方面，现货以太坊ETF已经连续23个交易日录得净流出，机构层面的持续赎回构成了沉重的结构性压力。

值得关注的是，FBI已确认朝鲜黑客组织TraderTraitor为币安63亿美元盗窃案的幕后黑手，而黑客正在将盗取的ETH通过DeFi协议和即时兑换服务进行洗钱。以太坊链上的一次意外区块重组曾短暂打断了通过THORChain的洗钱进程，为调查人员争取了宝贵时间。目前约30亿美元的被盗资产已被冻结在链上。

从市场整体来看，十月份加密市场总市值从2.94万亿美元缩水至2.58万亿美元，蒸发了约3600亿美元。稳定币总供应下降至2985亿美元，为八月以来的最低水平。在这样的宏观背景下，ETH能够维持相对强势，质押锁仓带来的供应收缩功不可没。

title: BTC站上78,000但别急着欢呼：涨幅仅0.96%，恐贪指数还在34的恐惧区
subTitle:
先看数据，不谈情绪。📊

据 HTX 行情，BTC 突破 78,000 美元，现报 78,001.20 美元，24 小时涨幅 0.96%。实时报价 77,990.37，涨幅收窄至 +0.91%。这是一个"突破"，但幅度上更接近区间内的技术性上移，而非趋势性放量拉升。

把镜头拉远，结构更清晰：
• 30 日涨跌：-8.0%
• 7 日涨跌：-2.7%
• 30 日区间：77,368.77 – 86,530.00

也就是说，现价 77,990 处于近 30 日区间的下沿附近，本次"突破 78,000"更像是从区间底部向上的一次修复，距离区间中轴仍有距离。单日 0.96% 的涨幅，不足以定义方向。

再看市场内部：
• $ETH 2,269.41（+1.14%），涨幅略强于 $BTC
• $BNB 705.59（+0.34%），跟随偏弱
• 恐贪指数 34，处于 Fear 区间

这里有一个值得注意的背离：价格站上整数关口，但情绪指标仍在恐惧区。历史上，情绪与价格的背离往往意味着两种可能——要么是底部区域的筑底特征，要么是反弹缺乏共识、后续动能不足。仅凭单日数据无法定论，需要观察成交量与后续能否守住 78,000 一线。

结论：这是一次"数据上成立、结构上待确认"的突破。整数关口的心理意义大于技术意义，真正需要跟踪的是 30 日区间下沿 77,368 是否被有效守住，以及恐贪指数能否持续回升脱离恐惧区。

⚠️ 风险提示：以上为行情数据梳理与结构分析，不构成任何投资建议。加密资产波动剧烈，30 日 -8.0% 的回撤已说明风险，请务必控制仓位、独立判断。

你怎么看这次 78,000 的"突破"——是修复起点，还是区间内的假动作？👇

#BTC #行情分析 #恐贪指数 #ETH #风险提示

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, 10x leverage means 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing a “Insufficient margin” alert,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin threshold: Once losses eat into the required maintenance margin, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose between “isolated margin” and “cross margin.” Many beginners just pick one at random and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross Margin】Your entire account balance is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in extreme market conditions, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one
They all support one another in the same basket.

【Isolated Margin】Only a specific amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the losses won't spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My advice】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you don't yet have the ability to assess the worst-case scenario for a bad trade

【Like 2017’s “functionality first, security later”: the smarter the upgrade, the more dangerous the permissions】

Don’t focus only on ETH’s price moves this time around. The FBI confirmed North Korea’s involvement in the $6 billion Binance hack and asked the DeFi community to freeze addresses linked to BTC, ETH, and SOL. The attackers also exploited Ethereum’s 2025 wallet upgrade: it was meant to make ordinary wallets smarter, but they used 50 signatures from Binance’s wallet to carry out their actions.

In plain English: the cashier gets permission to make automatic payments, but 50 pre-signed payment slips end up in someone else’s hands. A “smarter” wallet isn’t necessarily a “safer” one.

In practice, exchanges, wallet providers, and DeFi protocols will bear the initial security and compensation burden. ETH holders, meanwhile, could get dragged down by panic and liquidations. More than $1.57 billion in crypto positions were liquidated across the market, ETH fell 4.2% in a week, and the Fear and Greed Index stood at just 34. The business logic is clear, too: if a better user experience widens the permission gap, the steps saved today could turn into a much bigger hole later.

Keep this in mind: don’t treat a wallet upgrade as automatically bullish. First check how permissions are granted, how old permissions can be revoked, and whether suspicious transactions can be blocked.

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100 U control 1,000 U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are just getting started ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100 U in capital and use 10x leverage, you actually control
a position worth 1,000 U. If the coin price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your principal; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note, the loss is calculated based on the total position you control.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the coin price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you have to lose 10% before it’s all gone; a drop of about 10% wipes it all out (the exact threshold also depends on the margin rate).

I reread the $100 per payment rule in Kite’s Standing Intent example and kept thinking about the $1,000 daily ceiling. Ten permitted mistakes are still ten mistakes.

That is the gap between cryptographic authorization and economic usefulness. Kite’s user → agent → session structure narrows delegated authority. Passport adds time-limited budgets, and x402 lets an agent purchase API access without holding its owner’s private key. Sensible design. Still, a valid signature doesn't mean the user wanted that purchase.

Now picture ten agents spending from one treasury. Budget checks must be atomic or simultaneous requests may overrun the allowance. Settlement is another incomplete test: did the paid API return usable data, and can the buyer reconcile that delivery against a receipt? A prompt injection could produce an entirely authorized payment. Who then pays for the mistake?

The $4.4 trillion opportunity often attached to AI is not a transaction ledger. AI created value, service spending, merchant revenue and protocol fees are separate. Kite has to show repeated commercial demand, not just busy wallets. And KITE utility should be measured against actual fee capture, not assumed from volume.

I'd watch returning paying agents, service failures, revocation delays and net fees after incentives. A payment can be perfectly authorized and economically pointless.

#KiteBBW @GoKiteAI

The USDC Treasury’s mint is significant because it signals the accelerating adoption of major stablecoins on non-traditional blockchains. More importantly, it could encourage more players from traditional financial markets to enter DeFi, since USDC, as a relatively stable asset, lowers the barriers to entering the crypto world.

Market impact

Bitcoin and Ethereum may not feel a significant impact immediately in the short term, but over the long term, overall growth in the DeFi ecosystem could indirectly drive up the value of these major cryptocurrencies. In addition, this event could prompt regulators to reassess their approach to regulating DeFi, as the influx of more traditional financial assets into the sector may attract regulatory scrutiny.

Trading strategy
The large-scale USDC mint on Solana could provide fresh momentum for the platform’s growth, particularly in DeFi liquidity. This means investors should keep an eye on further developments in the Solana ecosystem and whether this growth can translate into positive momentum across the broader cryptocurrency market. However, it remains uncertain whether this growth is sustainable, as the DeFi market continues to be affected by regulatory and policy changes.

OpenAI announced it was cutting its fundraising target in half to $20 billion, while Meta was warned by S&P about the risk of a credit default. Although these two events are unrelated, they both point to a reality: the AI boom may be getting a little overextended. For OpenAI, the impact is direct pressure on its funding; for Meta, it’s the market cooling its high-flying valuation. For crypto markets, it means the AI frenzy may be returning to a more rational footing.

Why does this news matter?
OpenAI’s fundraising cut signals two things: first, the market is indeed starting to question whether AI companies can deliver on their promises; second, Silicon Valley’s investment logic is changing. The warning to Meta from S&P is even more direct proof that high valuations are no cure-all for tech giants. These two events are happening as BTC and ETH fluctuate around 77K and 2250—not by coincidence. This means that if the pace of AI commercialization slows, the impact on risk appetite could be greater than expected.

Industry cycles, regulatory trends, and capital flows are all changing. In the past, you could raise money just by saying “AI.” Now the market is starting to ask, “What can this AI actually do?” Is this connected to other recent events? For example, Solana just surged 11%, while BNB rose only a modest 0.64%. This reflects the market’s divided response to the AI narrative—not every AI project is benefiting. A deeper reason may be that VCs have realized AI projects are highly homogeneous, with many simply reinventing the wheel and few delivering genuine breakthroughs.

Market impact
The impact on BTC and ETH is primarily sentiment-driven, and could trigger profit-taking in the short term. BTC has support around 77K, but if the AI boom cools, capital may flow out of crypto and into traditional tech stocks. Over the long term, if AI develops faster than expected, crypto and traditional finance will integrate more quickly. A similar historical event? During the 2000 bubble burst, many internet companies also saw their commercialization slow. But this time is different: AI’s development speed and penetration rate are far beyond what they were back then.

The impact on the regulatory environment is greater. S&P’s warning to Meta may make regulators think it’s “time to step in,” especially since Meta is still pursuing its metaverse ambitions. As for capital flows, investors may first pull out of the riskiest AI stocks and crypto projects, then watch to see which AI applications are truly useful. If OpenAI is indeed short on funds, its IP could be sold at a low price, benefiting some competitors.

Trading strategy
For BTC and ETH, these two news stories are more like confirmation that prices are trading within a range. Support below 77K remains unchanged for now, but the resistance at 80K warrants more caution. If AI investment shifts from “investing with eyes closed” to “selective investing,” market sentiment will become more complicated. This means it won’t be easy to take either a bullish or bearish position in the short term; the key is which AI companies can deliver real results.

This view would be invalidated if Meta starts laying off staff or stops investing in the metaverse.

行业周期、监管趋势和资金面都在变。以前是只要说 AI 就能圈钱，现在市场开始问“这个 AI 到底能带来什么”。和近期其他事件关联吗？比如 Solana 刚刚暴涨 11%，但 BNB 也就 0.64% 小涨。这反映了市场对 AI 概念分化，不是所有 AI 都能沾光。更深层的原因可能是，VC 发现 AI 项目同质化严重，很多想法都是重复造轮子，真正突破的不多。

对市场的影响
对 BTC 和 ETH 的影响是情绪层面的，短期内可能引发获利了结。BTC 77K 附近有支撑，但一旦 AI 热潮降温，资金可能从加密流向传统科技股。长期看，如果 AI 发展超预期，加密和传统会加速融合。历史类似事件？2000 年泡沫破裂时，很多互联网概念公司也经历了资本化放缓。但这次不一样的是，AI 的发展速度和渗透率确实远超当年。

对监管环境的影响更大。Meta 被 S&P 警告可能让监管机构觉得“该出手了”，尤其 Meta 还在搞元宇宙概念。资金流向方面，资金可能会先撤离风险最高的 AI 股票和加密项目，然后观察哪些 AI 真有用武之地。如果 OpenAI 确实资金紧张，其 IP 可能被低价出售，利好某些竞争对手。

操作思路
这两条新闻对 BTC 和 ETH 来说，更像是确认区间震荡。77K 下方的支撑位暂时没变，但上方 80K 的压力位需要更谨慎看待。如果 AI 投资策略从“闭眼投”变成“精选投”，那么市场情绪会变得复杂。意味着短期内看多/看空都不容易，关键看哪些 AI 公司能拿出真东西。

如果 Meta 开始裁员或者停止元宇宙投入，这个判断作废。

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事

合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Does It Mean to Pay Fuel Costs on a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay Gas fees to transfer tokens or mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to the token price】A booming market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing Gas fees. That’s why seasoned users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

subTitle:
November 3 could prove one of the most consequential days of 2026 for financial markets.
The U.S. midterm elections are two days away. The outcome will shape the legislative and geopolitical environment for stocks, crypto, energy, and the broader global economy through the rest of this year and into 2027.
Prediction markets currently assign Democrats a high probability of winning the House (roughly 92–94%) and a solid chance of taking the Senate (around 70–72%). A Democratic sweep of both chambers sits near the 70% range in several major platforms.
Three areas deserve particular attention from investors:
1. AI stocks
House Democrats recently introduced a resolution opposing any government bailout for AI companies or related financial institutions in the event of a collapse in the AI sector. The measure, led by Ranking Member Maxine Waters and Progressive Caucus Chair Greg Casar, explicitly rejects taxpayer rescues, emergency lending, or protection for executives, arguing that failing firms should go through ordinary bankruptcy processes. This comes against a backdrop of growing concern over the scale of capital being deployed into AI infrastructure and elevated valuations.
2. Crypto regulation
In September, every Senate Democrat voted against advancing the CLARITY Act, the major digital-asset market-structure bill. The procedural failure effectively stalled comprehensive crypto legislation for the remainder of this Congress. A Democratic majority in either or both chambers would likely make negotiations over future market-structure and regulatory clarity more complex and potentially slower.
3. Geopolitical risk — Iran
Multiple reports indicate that the U.S. has warned Middle Eastern allies to prepare for the possibility of renewed military action against Iran after November 3. Any resumption of significant strikes would raise the risk of higher oil prices, supply disruptions, and renewed inflationary pressure.
This election is therefore about more than partisan control of Congress. The results could influence the regulatory stance toward AI, the path of crypto legislation, and the near-term trajectory of energy markets and geopolitical risk premiums. All three have the potential to affect how risk assets trade for the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.
Markets will be watching closely.#BTC #eth #solana $TRUMP

ETH at around $2,268 | Binance says withdrawals on 15 networks have resumed | I’ll verify the routes before considering a long

I view the resumption of withdrawals as progress toward restoring liquidity, but not as a direct signal that ETH will rise. Trending topics on Binance Square are still discussing withdrawal services. On November 1, the Binance News verified account said withdrawals for major assets had reopened on 15 networks. Binance’s earlier fourth recovery notice listed the specific assets available on each network and emphasized that services would resume in phases based on stability and security checks. For ETH, the notice listed ETH, USDT, and USDC as withdrawable on Ethereum mainnet; ETH and the two stablecoins were also listed on Arbitrum and Optimism, while Base listed ETH and USDC. “15 networks” refers to the platform as a whole; it absolutely does not mean any asset can be sent over any network.

What matters more to me than how many networks have reopened is whether the asset, network, and destination address selected by the user all match. ETH on mainnet, ETH on Arbitrum, and ETH on Base are all called ETH, but they arrive on different chains. If the receiving platform supports only mainnet, choosing the wrong L2 network may prevent the funds from being credited automatically. With a self-custody wallet, you also need to confirm the destination network, fees, and whether you’ll need to bridge the funds afterward. Ethereum’s official documentation treats L2s as independent scaling networks, which is why “the withdrawal button is back” does not mean the funds have safely reached their final destination. Before making a large transfer, I would first send a small test amount and check the on-chain transaction status.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Flat Is a Position Too—and It’s the One the Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have is that if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and volatility grind away their capital.

In reality, staying flat is the only position with zero losses. When the market is too hard to read, stay flat,
Staying flat when bulls and bears are battling it out, and staying flat after a few losing trades in a row—the money you save in these three moments
is more than most people make from trading.

You may be tired of the hunting metaphor, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes only a second. You need capital on hand so you have bullets when opportunity comes. Hold on to your bullets.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (execution), and
what you’ll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover that your losses…
Your trade log is full of the same mistakes repeated over and over—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or always cutting winning trades short.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

On the same Layer 2 network, why did fees drop so much after the Cancun upgrade?
The Fusaka upgrade in December 2025 introduced PeerDAS, allowing nodes to sample only a portion of blob data. The blob limit was also raised afterward.

When Layer 2 networks submit blob data to the mainnet, they also pay blob fees settled in $ETH .

Many people think the Cancun upgrade and blobs are simple, but this is where it’s easy to get things wrong:
Blob data cannot be accessed by the EVM; contracts only see versioned hashes calculated from the blobs’ KZG commitments.
“Proto-Danksharding” is the first step toward full Danksharding: first, the transaction format and fee mechanism for blobs are established, and capacity will be gradually increased later.
When comparing fees across Layer 2 networks, distinguish between the Layer 2’s own execution fees and the cost of submitting data to mainnet—both can fluctuate.
When Layer 2 networks write blob data to mainnet, the blob fee is also settled at $ETH . Currently 2267.84.

title: BEFORE YOU CONNECT YOUR CRYPTO WALLET, STOP AND CHECK THESE 5 THINGS!
subTitle:
One careless wallet connection can expose your digital assets to serious risks.
In crypto, protecting your wallet is just as important as choosing what to invest in.
Here are 5 checks everyone should make before connecting a wallet to a website, dApp, or platform:
1️⃣ VERIFY THE WEBSITE
Check the website address carefully. Fake websites can look almost identical to legitimate platforms. Use official links from verified project channels.
2️⃣ QUESTION UNEXPECTED REQUESTS
Be cautious when a website asks you to connect your wallet urgently or promises rewards for doing so. Pressure and excitement can make people careless.
3️⃣ NEVER SHARE YOUR RECOVERY PHRASE
Your seed phrase or private key gives access to your wallet. Never share it with anyone or enter it into an unfamiliar website. Legitimate support teams should never ask you for it.
4️⃣ READ BEFORE YOU APPROVE
Connecting a wallet and approving a transaction are not necessarily the same thing. Read transaction and token-approval requests carefully. Understand what permissions you are granting.
5️⃣ REVIEW AND REVOKE RISKY APPROVALS
Where supported, regularly review your wallet's token approvals and revoke permissions you no longer need. Remember, disconnecting a website does not always revoke token approvals.
💡 A LESSON TO REMEMBER:
Your wallet is not just an app. It is access to your digital assets.
Never let curiosity, fear of missing out, or promises of free rewards make security decisions for you.
COMMUNITY QUESTION:
Have you ever received a message asking you to connect your wallet to claim free tokens, rewards, or an airdrop?
What did you do?

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | The Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotionally charged days, people forget every principle, so I wrote these down and put them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before opening a position. If you can’t, don’t open one.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three consecutive losses, stop trading for the day. Just watch—don’t trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is money; what you keep is peace of mind.

That’s all five. Not one is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big
is never that they read the market wrong—it’s that their execution slips. Let’s keep each other accountable.

translatedData.content:
ETH around $2,261 | “23 consecutive days of ETF outflows” does not match the data | I’ll stay disciplined and wait for a turning point in fund flows

My stance is cautious and somewhat bearish, but I won’t accept panic being fueled by an incorrect count of consecutive days. A trending post on Binance Square claimed that U.S. spot ETH ETFs had seen net outflows for 23 consecutive days. I checked Farside’s daily table directly: there was a net inflow of $14.9 million on October 21 and a net inflow of $4.4 million on October 23, so “23 consecutive days” cannot be correct. A more accurate statement is that, as of October 30, there were net outflows on the five reported trading days from October 26 to 30, totaling about $431.4 million, including a single-day net outflow of $155.7 million on the 30th. There is no new U.S. trading-day data over the weekend; anyone combining calendar days or outflows from a single fund to claim 23 consecutive days of market-wide outflows is using the wrong measure. The data is already weak enough without exaggeration.

Why do ETF flows matter for ETH? Fund creations and redemptions can affect authorized participants’ hedging and expectations for spot demand. Outflows over multiple consecutive days can make buyers less willing to step in during a rebound. But net outflow amounts cannot be equated directly with spot selling pressure on that day: fund-share trading, cash management, hedging, and timing differences can all affect how flows are transmitted. The SEC’s rules on how investment advisers and funds should custody crypto assets are still at the proposal stage; they do not mean that a new ETH fund has been approved. On October 28, the Fed held the federal funds rate at 3.75% to 4%, with two officials favoring a rate hike. That’s another reminder not to interpret the liquidity environment as unconditionally positive. On the other hand, Binance’s announcement about recovery from the security incident said that balances in ten assets, including ETH, were backed 100%, and that about 95% of affected assets overall had been replenished. Those are two different denominators, not evidence against the ETF-flow data.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, ETH/USD was around $2,261 on Kraken, with a 24-hour range of roughly $2,241 to $2,275; the price is still moving within a narrow range. I’m watching $2,240 first on the downside, then $2,200 if that level gives way; on the upside, $2,275 and $2,300 are the levels I’ll use to assess whether a recovery is taking shape. My short-term view is that fund flows are weighing on any rebound. But if ETFs return to net inflows on the next trading day and ETH holds above $2,300 on increased volume, I’ll need to withdraw my bearish view. If there is a new anomaly in exchange withdrawals or $2,240 is decisively broken, I’ll raise my defensive priorities further. Any single day of inflows is only a sign of improvement; it cannot guarantee a trend reversal.

If I were trading this myself, I would not enter a trade right now; I’d stay on the sidelines, with 0% in additional spot positions and 0% in futures. I would only use at most 3% of my total capital to try a long if ETH closes above $2,300 for two consecutive one-hour candles, holds above $2,275 on a retest, and ETF flows stop being net negative on the next trading day. I’d first target $2,350 and take half off there, then look to $2,400. I’d set a stop-loss below $2,255, and close the entire position if the one-hour candle closes back below $2,240. If $2,240 breaks first, I wouldn’t reverse and chase a short; I’d wait and reassess fund flows and liquidity around $2,200. If the conditions aren’t met, there’s no trade and no profit to review.

content:
ETH约2261美元｜“ETF连续23日流出”与数据不符｜我先守纪律等资金拐点

我的态度是谨慎偏弱，但不接受用错误的连续天数制造恐慌。币安广场热榜出现“美国现货ETHETF连续23日净流出”。我直接查Farside逐日表：10月21日合计净流入1490万美元，10月23日也净流入440万美元，所以“连续23日”不能成立。较准确的表述是：截至10月30日，10月26日至30日这五个已公布交易日连续净流出，合计约4.314亿美元，其中30日单日净流出1.557亿美元。周末没有新的美国交易日数据；若有人把自然日或单只基金流出拼成全市场连续23日，就是口径错误。数据本身已经偏弱，无须夸大。

为什么ETF流向对ETH重要？基金申购赎回会影响授权参与者的对冲与现货需求预期，连续多日流出容易让反弹时的主动买盘退缩。但不能把净流出金额直接等同于当日现货抛压：基金份额交易、现金安排、对冲与时间差都会改变传导。SEC关于投资顾问和基金如何托管加密资产的规则仍处于提案阶段，并非新的ETH基金获批。美联储10月28日维持联邦基金利率在3.75%至4%，两名委员倾向加息，这也提醒我别把流动性环境解读成无条件利好。另一方面，币安关于安全事件的恢复公告给出ETH等十种余额100%背书、受影响资产整体约95%补足；这是两个分母，不是对ETH ETF流向的反证。

市场已经如何反应？撰稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2261美元，近24小时大致2241至2275美元，价格仍在窄幅震荡。下方先看2240，失守后看2200；上方2275与2300依次是我验证修复的价位。我的短期判断是资金面压制反弹，但若下一交易日ETF重新转为净流入且ETH放量站稳2300，偏弱判断需要撤回；如果出现新的交易所提现异常或2240被有效跌破，防守优先级继续提高。任何单日流入都只是改善信号，不能保证趋势反转。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向观望，新增现货仓位0%，合约仓位0%。只有ETH在2300美元上方连续两根一小时K线收盘、回踩2275不破，且下一交易日ETF总流向停止净流出，我才用总资金最多3%试多；目标先看2350，触及先减半，再看2400。止损设在2255下方，一小时收盘重新跌破2240则全部平仓。若先跌破2240，我不反手追空，等待2200附近重新观察资金和流动性；条件未满足就是没有成交，也没有收益可复盘。

Crypto 101 📚 The Cancun upgrade and blobs
The Fusaka upgrade in December 2025 introduced PeerDAS, allowing nodes to sample only a portion of the blob data. The blob limit was later increased as well.
Blob data is stored only by consensus-layer nodes for about 4,096 epochs, or roughly 18 days, after which it is deleted.
The first page of my study notes says: Understand it before placing an order.
When Layer 2 networks write blob data to the mainnet, the blob fees are also settled in $ETH .

First, what are blobs, and why do they make Layer 2 cheaper?
When the Cancun upgrade went live, each block had a target of 3 blobs and a maximum of 6; the Pectra upgrade in May 2025 raised that to a target of 6 and a maximum of 9.
Blobs have a separate fee market: the blob base fee adjusts automatically based on the difference between usage and the target, and it is also burned.
When demand for blobs suddenly rises, blob fees go up too, so Layer 2 fees aren't always that cheap.
Layer 2 networks pay blob fees when submitting blob data to mainnet, and those fees are also settled in $ETH . Currently 2262.5.

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月一日，以太坊报价两千二百六十八美元，过去二十四小时上涨百分之零点九六。从小时K线来看，ETH在过去五个小时内经历了从两千二百七十六美元到两千二百六十美元的回落过程，最新一根小时K线跌幅较大，从两千二百七十美元跌至两千二百六十美元，成交量放大至一千二百九十五万美元，显示抛压有所增加。

从均线系统分析，七日均线约两千二百七十美元与二十五日均线约两千二百六十一美元基本持平，短期均线走平，方向选择迫在眉睫。九十九日均线位于两千二百七十九美元，对价格形成上方压制。当前价格运行在九十九日均线下方，表明中期趋势偏弱。布林带上轨约两千二百七十八美元，中轨约两千二百六十四美元，下轨约两千二百五十美元，价格在中轨附近震荡，带宽持续收窄。

值得注意的是，以太坊面临一个特殊的供给压力。根据链上数据，黑客通过一百三十多种代币互换，将约十二万三千四百枚ETH（价值约两亿七千九百万美元）注入市场，形成了巨大的上方供给压力。这批被盗资产的持续抛售对ETH价格构成了直接的压制作用。

二、技术指标解读

RSI指标出现了剧烈变化，六周期RSI从八十一点一的超买区域急速下滑至三十二点六，已经接近超卖区域。十二周期RSI为四十七点一，二十四周期RSI为四十九点五，均处于中性偏弱水平。这种快速回落表明短期多头力量已经耗尽，市场正在经历获利回吐。

MACD方面，DIF线为四点六三，DEA线为五点零九，柱状图已经从正一点五缩小至负零点四六，形成了死叉信号。这是明确的短期看跌信号，暗示未来数个小时内ETH可能继续承压。

KDJ指标同样偏空，K值四十四点一，D值五十七点零，J值十八点三，三线向下运行。威廉指标WR从负五点八恶化至负六十九点七，已经进入超卖区域。随机RSI从八十二点一下滑至二十六点七，同样确认了短期弱势。

不过，综合量化因子显示，十五个因子中七个看多、七个看空、一个中性，复合指标信号为看多，历史胜率高达百分之八十五点一，其中做多胜率为百分之九十四点七。这意味着虽然短期技术面偏弱，但中期模型仍然偏向乐观。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的市场情绪较为复杂。一方面，币安恢复提币缓解了市场的恐慌情绪，交易所确认ETH百分之百储备，稳定了持有者的信心。十月份链上质押参与量创历史新高，锁定的供给为市场提供了一定的支撑。

What exactly is a blob, and how can it reduce Layer 2 fees?
The Ethereum Cancun upgrade (Dencun) was activated on March 13, 2024. Its most important change was EIP-4844, also known as Proto-Danksharding. Blob data cannot be read by the EVM; contracts can only access a versioned hash calculated from the blob’s KZG commitment.
Blobs are cheap because blob data is stored for only about 18 days and doesn’t need to be stored permanently or processed by the EVM, putting much less pressure on nodes.
When Layer 2 networks submit blob data to mainnet, the blob fee they pay is also settled in $ETH .

translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly keep their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days a year gives you 12 times your money; steadily earning 10% a month
gives you 30 times your money over three years. It may not sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities have to be waited for; discipline is your own. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former comes from the market,
while the ability behind the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

Let's talk about the Cancun upgrade and blobs.
Blob data is stored only by consensus-layer nodes for about 4096 epochs, or roughly 18 days, and is deleted after that.
One thing that's easy to overlook: blobs are cheap because their data is kept for only about 18 days, doesn't need to be stored permanently, and isn't processed by the EVM, which puts much less pressure on nodes.
When demand for blobs surges, blob fees will also rise, so Layer 2 transaction fees won't always be so cheap.
When Layer 2 networks submit blob data to mainnet, they pay blob fees in $ETH  as well. Current price: 2269.84.

translatedData.content:
ETH reserves are fully backed | Overall platform recovery is about 95% | Check both sets of figures near $2,265

My stance is to remain cautious and not conflate proof of reserves for a single asset with the platform-wide rate of losses recovered. Binance Square is still discussing “Binance has replenished 90% of affected assets,” but Binance’s fourth official update on November 1 put progress at about 95%, up from roughly 90% in the previous update and about 80% earlier. At the same time, the official update listed ten assets, including ETH, BTC, and USDT, whose user balances are 100% backed and can be checked against proof-of-reserves snapshots. The 100% figure applies to balances of the listed tokens; the 95% figure refers to progress in recovering all assets affected by this incident. They have different denominators, so it does not follow that all long-tail assets have been fully replenished.

The official explanation is that the remaining roughly 5% consists mainly of less liquid tokens outside the ten listed assets, which are still being sourced through market and over-the-counter channels. My independent assessment is that progress from 90% to 95% helps ease concerns about the redemption of major assets, but as the process nears completion, the depth of the market for long-tail tokens and the execution timeline deserve closer attention. ETH users should check three things separately: the reserves snapshot reflects assets and liabilities at a particular point in time; the withdrawal page shows whether a specific network and token are currently available; and the incident investigation report addresses the vulnerability and subsequent controls. Progress on any one of these cannot substitute for the other two. Binance’s official Chinese-language account has confirmed that ETH, USDT, and USDC withdrawals on Ethereum mainnet have resumed. If using Arbitrum, Base, or Optimism, check each network’s live status separately; do not infer its status from mainnet.

The market has not provided evidence of a decisive breakout in either direction. Kraken ETH/USD is around $2,266, with a 24-hour range of about $2,241–$2,275, still near the upper end but not clearly above it. US spot ETFs have no new trading-day data over the weekend. The latest trading day in Farside’s data, October 30, still showed net outflows of about $155.7 million. Improved reserves may ease the platform risk premium, but ETF demand, macro interest-rate expectations, and the token price each have their own drivers; the current price movement cannot be attributed entirely to this announcement.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and consider only a small, unleveraged spot position with a bullish bias. I would enter with 4% of total capital only if ETH moves above $2,275 and holds on a retest, while official ETH mainnet withdrawal status remains normal. I would take half off at the first target of $2,295, then half of the remaining position at the second target of $2,320, and use $2,265 as a trailing exit level for the rest. The initial stop-loss is $2,250; if hit, I would close the position immediately. If ETH first falls below $2,241, withdrawals are paused again, or subsequent official data contradicts the backing of major assets, this short-term recovery thesis is invalidated: cancel any unfilled orders and close any open positions. The key things to watch are progress in settling the remaining 5% and price confirmation—not chasing the first move after the announcement.

ETH储备已全额背书｜平台整体补足约95%｜2265美元附近先核对两套口径

官方解释剩下约5%主要是十种资产之外、流动性较薄的代币，仍通过市场和场外渠道采购。我的独立判断是：进度从90%升至95%有利于降低头部资产的兑付疑虑，但越接近尾声，长尾代币的采购深度和执行时间越值得跟踪。ETH用户尤其要把三件事分开核对：储备快照反映某个时点的资产和负债，提币页面显示当前具体网络与币种是否可用，事故调查报告则回答漏洞及后续控制问题。任何一项进展都不能替代另外两项。官方华语账号已确认以太坊主网ETH、USDT、USDC提现恢复；若要用Arbitrum、Base或Optimism，仍须分别看实时页面，不能由主网状态类推。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You Hold a Losing Position
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% on a position looking at? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Remember, that thought is pure attachment, with no logic behind it. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to current supply and demand.

Once you're stuck holding a losing position, you automatically collect bullish signals and block out bearish ones. This is called confirmation bias. You start to think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
fails,” then act when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate decision-making from holding the position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

Reading the peers

Peer one shows hourly down pressure with volume not above baseline. Peer two shows hourly up pressure with volume likewise not above baseline. Meanwhile, the primary asset shows hourly down pressure with volume above baseline. The difference is not in the hourly drift alone. It is in the relative volume. This primary asset is trading on elevated activity against its recent average. The peers are not. Without measuring correlation, we cannot link these price paths. A flat list does not equal a causal tie. 

Where to look next

If relative volume stays above baseline and price holds near support, the hourly move could show persistence. If volume fades alongside the hourly drift, the move may lack follow through. Use relative volume as a soft filter, not a signal. The daily view provides more context. If the current pattern shifts, reassess whether the primary asset is leading, lagging, or simply noisy. In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: A Tug-of-War Between On-Chain Recovery and Institutional Retreat

November 1, 2026

I. Price Trend Analysis

Ethereum is currently trading at $2,271, up approximately 1.14% over the past 24 hours. On the hourly chart, the price has ranged between $2,265 and $2,278, showing an overall pattern of narrow-range trading. It briefly climbed to around $2,278 in the early session before retreating slightly and consolidating above $2,270.

Ethereum’s recent price action has been closely tied to the platform security incident. During the October 29 hack, a substantial portion of the stolen funds was transferred through the Ethereum network. Of the more than 600 addresses linked to the case disclosed by the FBI, the hackers had converted more than 130 altcoins into approximately 123,400 ETH, worth about $279 million, and attempted to evade stablecoin freezes through the Tron DeFi protocol. This news temporarily weighed on Ethereum’s price.

Notably, an unexpected reorganization of the Ethereum blockchain inadvertently disrupted the hackers’ money-laundering process. First, a question: Is a protocol guaranteed to be safe just because it has been audited?
Once a smart contract is deployed, it executes according to its code. If a vulnerability is exploited, funds may be stolen and difficult to recover.
If the code is changed after the audit, or the version actually deployed differs from the audited version, the audit findings may not fully apply.
When you come across a new protocol offering an annualized yield significantly higher than its peers, check whether it has been audited, whether the team is publicly known, and whether the contracts can be upgraded arbitrarily.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A stop-loss isn’t an admission of failure—it’s a ticket to your next opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to set a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more often right, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I’ve ever seen are quicker than anyone to admit when they’re wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter; what matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself
this: It’s the price of admission, not a verdict.

🚨 Binance withdrawals are back! But the real clue is in “the chain that’s still closed”
 
Just now, Binance’s Chinese-language account announced a phased resumption of withdrawals. A quick look at the list reveals something interesting:
 
✅ Open: BTC network, ETH network (including USDT/USDC), BSC network, XRP network, Base network.
❌ Still closed: TRX (Tron) network, SOL network (not mentioned).
 
People in the comments are already getting impatient: “Weren’t they supposed to reopen between 2 and 5? Why is the TRX network still closed?”
 
As a trader, what does this tell us?
 
1. The official move is to “steady market nerves”
Reopening the three major networks—BTC, ETH, and BSC—first is intended to reassure the market. Being able to deposit and withdraw major assets shows that core funds are safe and system liquidity is recovering.
 
2. Why is TRX the one that’s still blocked?
Taking into account the theft from a couple of days ago, hackers converted large amounts of assets into TRX to launder money. The FBI has also just named North Korean hacking group TraderTraitor and called for it to be intercepted. The Tron network is likely now holding a huge amount of “dirty money” and facing intense anti-money laundering (AML) scrutiny. The official team won’t risk reopening it lightly: once withdrawals are enabled, hackers could exploit the opportunity to move assets out, and the risk-control system could start sounding alarms across the board.
 
3. The critical impact on the market (what should we watch next?)
A few days ago, the withdrawal suspension caused a 5% price gap between on-chain markets and exchanges, splitting liquidity. Now that withdrawals have resumed on major networks, cross-market arbitrage channels are reopening.
• On-chain premiums and discounts will disappear almost instantly.
• Funds that were trapped on exchanges by the panic and unable to get out can finally move freely. This means the real test of selling pressure may not emerge until this wave of withdrawals has been absorbed.
 
💡 Trading advice:
Don’t blindly go long just because withdrawals have resumed and assume all the bad news is priced in. The hackers’ $3 billion sword of Damocles is still hanging overhead, and the real battle over liquidity is only just beginning. Keep a close eye on net inflows and outflows after deposits and withdrawals resume for major coins, and trade with the trend!

Most people think the Cancun upgrade and blobs are pretty straightforward, but this is what really matters:
Blob data is stored only by consensus-layer nodes for around 4,096 epochs, or about 18 days, after which it is deleted.
Blobs are cheap because blob data is stored for only about 18 days and doesn't need to be kept permanently. It also isn't involved in EVM computation, so it places a much smaller burden on nodes.
When comparing fees on layer 2 networks, distinguish between the layer 2's own execution fees and the cost of submitting data to mainnet. Both can vary.
When a layer 2 network writes blob data to mainnet, the blob fee is also paid in $ETH .

ETH Mainnet Withdrawals Resume; Layer 2 Networks Still Need to Be Checked Individually; Wait for a Breakout Near $2,266

My stance is to watch cautiously. I wouldn’t take the restoration of a single withdrawal channel on an exchange as proof that the entire Ethereum ecosystem has returned to normal, and I certainly wouldn’t use it as a reason to chase prices higher. Binance Square’s trending topics are discussing “Binance Resumes Withdrawal Services on the Ethereum Network and BNB Smart Chain.” Binance’s official news and verified Chinese-language accounts have so far explicitly confirmed that ETH, USDT, and USDC withdrawals on the Ethereum mainnet have resumed, as have BNB, USDT, and USDC withdrawals on BNB Smart Chain. Other assets and networks will continue to come back in phases. This is progress for withdrawal services; it does not mean that deposits and withdrawals for every coin on every chain are open at the same time.

It’s especially important to distinguish between “ETH” and the “withdrawal network”—they are two separate fields. The earlier resumption plan listed the ETH mainnet, Arbitrum, Base, and Optimism as part of the initial rollout, but being “included in the plan” is not the same as being “open” now. For the moment, I consider only the Ethereum mainnet to have resumed, based on the latest explicit official confirmation. Whether ETH can be withdrawn on Layer 2 networks still depends on the live status of the relevant network on the withdrawal page. If users mistakenly select a Layer 2 network for mainnet assets, or overlook which networks the receiving address supports, the risk is greater than simply paying a little extra in fees. The restoration of platform channels can reduce friction for transferring some assets and may ease panic, but it does not prove that the underlying Ethereum network ever went down, nor that all of the platform’s liquidity issues are over.

The market reaction has been fairly restrained so far. ETH/USD was around $2,266 on Kraken, with a 24-hour high of about $2,275 and a low of about $2,241; the price remains below the top of the range. This price movement can’t simply be attributed to the withdrawal news. Flows have not offered confirmation in the same direction either: Farside’s figures show net outflows of about $155.7 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on October 30. There are no new U.S. fund trading-day figures over the weekend, so I’d rather wait for Binance to roll out more withdrawals and for the next trading day’s fund flows before judging whether the recovery in sentiment will last.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter for now. The only direction I’d consider is a small spot position to test the waters on the long side; I wouldn’t touch leverage. I’d enter with about 4% of my total capital only if ETH decisively moves above $2,275, holds on a retest, and Binance’s withdrawal status for the corresponding ETH mainnet remains normal. If it breaks out and immediately falls back below $2,260, I’d abandon the trade rather than chase it. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,295, then sell half of the remaining position at the second target of $2,320. I’d set the initial stop-loss at $2,250 and close the position if it is triggered. If the price first falls below $2,241, or if the official account suspends the relevant withdrawals again, my short-term recovery thesis is invalidated: I’d cancel any unfilled orders and exit existing positions without hesitation. The key is to verify the service and the price before taking on risk.

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

“Rolling profits into new positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, then roll it over a few times
and turn it into dozens of times your initial investment. Today, let’s talk about the part they don’t tell you.

【What Rolling Profits Into New Positions Means】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions,
It’s like using the market’s money to leverage your position. As long as the trend continues, the compounding is astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains can
of several dozen points can vanish to zero in just one or two big down candles.

【The Mathematical Reality】The essence of rolling profits into new positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Those posts about doubling your money overnight? Behind them are 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

EIP-4844 introduced a new transaction type that carries blobs. Each blob contains 4,096 32-byte data units, or about 128 KB.
Key point: When comparing Layer 2 network fees, remember to distinguish between the Layer 2 network’s own execution fees and the cost of submitting data to the mainnet. Both can change.
Layer 2 networks pay blob fees to submit blob data to the mainnet, and those fees are also settled in $ETH .
Understand the principles before taking action. Don’t make decisions based on gut feelings.

The roughly 95% replenishment, the remaining roughly 5% of low-liquidity coins, 100% reserves for the top ten coins, and the complete zero-knowledge proof due on November 3 were also previously announced updates. Officials had also said that initial failures are normal and users can try again later, so don’t keep submitting requests over and over.

$ETH: ETH Hourly Direction vs Peer Context

ETH trades below the 2266.49 with hourly direction down. Volume is 2.03648 against baseline. This setup contrasts with peers on the same venue. $BTC moves up with elevated volume. $AMP moves up without volume expansion. The shared upward direction among peers does not prove causal link to ETH. It also does not confirm sector rotation. The difference lies in how the move holds over time. ETH pulls back while others rise with varying conviction. This highlights that direction alone is insufficient for analysis. A key mechanism is volume confirmation. Price moves backed by volume above average suggest stronger participation. Without it, moves may reverse quickly. ETH currently lacks this confirmation despite directional pressure. Comparing across assets reveals that identical hourly direction can mask different underlying dynamics. One asset may absorb sell orders while another faces liquidity gaps. This explains why simple watchlist rankings mislead. They ignore internal structure of each move. To reassess, monitor whether ETH volume normalizes before price stabilizes. If volume drops while price remains below 2266.49, weakness persists. If volume spikes on the downside, stress increases. This approach separates fact from interpretation. It avoids assuming correlation exists where only shared timing appears. The evidence shows distinct behaviors within the same timeframe. Investors benefit from tracking how each asset responds to market shifts individually. This method prioritizes holding capacity over directional agreement.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

The comparison to keep in mind: $BTC has hourly direction up and volume above its baseline; $AMP has hourly direction up and volume not above its baseline. This alone does not establish correlation.

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Positions: Fortune Through Risk, or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Rolling positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, then roll it over several times
and multiply it dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about what those stories leave out.

【What Rolling Positions Means】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions and keep opening trades,
It's like using the market's money to leverage up. As long as the trend continues, compounding is incredible; when it stops, unrealized gains can go
from dozens of points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】The essence of rolling positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60%, the odds of winning four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve correctly spotted the trend and want to add to your position. How should you do it? Going all in from the start and adding until you’re fully loaded with unrealized gains is a recipe for ending up on the liquidation list.
A common mistake. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than the previous time. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
Once confirmed, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping your average cost low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, all your trades go off the rails.

The Shitcoin Legend: The Night That Changed My Fate

Chen was an honest, hardworking man. He’d worked as a programmer in Shenzhen for ten years. Every month, as soon as his salary came in, he transferred half to his wife’s account and kept the rest for the mortgage. He’d been trading crypto for three years, mostly losing money. He chased BTC from 60,000 to 80,000, and held ETH from 3,000 all the way down to 2,000. There were only 800 U left in his account, and even his wife didn’t know.

That night, he worked overtime until eleven. While scrolling through Binance Square, he came across a token called Niu Lai. It was priced at just 0.003 U, with a pitifully small market cap. The comments were in an uproar. Some said this shitcoin was bound to go to zero; others said the whales were accumulating and would pump it any minute. Chen was about to scroll past, but for some inexplicable reason, his finger tapped Buy. He went all in with his last 800 U.

He regretted it as soon as he bought. Eight hundred U! That was enough to pay for a whole semester of piano lessons for his daughter. He closed the app and tossed and turned in bed, unable to sleep. All he could think about was the disappointment in his wife’s eyes.

At seven the next morning, his phone wouldn’t stop buzzing. Still half asleep, he opened it and saw that Niu Lai was up 50 percent. He rubbed his eyes, thinking he must be seeing things. The price had risen from 0.003 to 0.0045, and his 800 U had become 1,200.

His heart raced, but he didn’t sell. He thought he’d wait a little longer. What if it went up to one cent?

Over the next three days, Niu Lai took off like a rocket. 0.01, 0.02, 0.05. Chen secretly checked the charts at work every day, his hands shaking so badly he could barely type. When a coworker asked what was wrong, he said he was fine, just had an upset stomach.

By the fifth day, Niu Lai had surged to 0.069. His 800 U had become 180,000.

Chen’s hands were trembling. 180,000—that was three months’ salary. He thought of the 20,000 he’d lost trading crypto for the first time three years ago, the 30,000 he’d lost chasing BTC last year, and all the relatives and friends who’d laughed at him for trading crypto.

He took a deep breath and sold everything.

When the money came in, he sat at his desk in a daze for a full five minutes. Then he opened WeChat and transferred 100,000 to his wife, with the note: “Put our daughter in piano lessons. Put the rest in a fixed-term deposit.”

His wife replied instantly: “Did you win the lottery?”

Chen smiled but didn’t reply. He turned his phone face down on the desk. The Shenzhen sunshine outside was lovely, and he suddenly felt that he might have used up all his luck in this one trade.

Later, Niu Lai rose to 0.072, then fell back to 0.05. But Chen no longer cared. He deleted the Binance app and took his daughter to a trial piano lesson that weekend.

When the little girl pressed the first piano key, Chen thought it sounded better than any hundred-bagger coin.

土狗币传奇：那个让我改变命运的夜晚

老陈是个老实人，在深圳做了十年程序员，每个月工资到账就转一半到老婆账户，剩下的留着还房贷。他炒币三年，亏多赚少，BTC从六万追到八万，ETH从三千拿到两千，账户里只剩下八百U，连老婆都不知道。

那天晚上加班到十一点，他刷币安广场看到一个叫牛来的代币，价格才零点零零三U，市值小得可怜。评论区吵翻了天，有人说这是土狗必归零，有人说庄家在建仓马上拉盘。老陈本来想划走，但手指鬼使神差地点了买入，把最后八百U全梭了。

买完他就后悔了。八百U啊，够给女儿报一学期的钢琴课。他关掉APP，躺在床上翻来覆去睡不着，脑子里全是老婆失望的眼神。

第二天早上七点，手机震个不停。他迷迷糊糊打开一看，牛来涨了百分之五十。他揉了揉眼睛，以为自己看花了。价格从零點零零三涨到了零点零零四五，他的八百U变成了一千二。

他心跳加速，但没卖。他想再等等，万一涨到一分钱呢。

接下来三天，牛来像坐了火箭。零点零一，零点零二，零点零五。老陈每天上班都在偷偷看盘，手抖得连键盘都敲不稳。同事问他怎么了，他说没事，胃不舒服。

到第五天，牛来冲到了零点零六九。他的八百U变成了十八万。

老陈的手在发抖。十八万，是他三个月的工资。他想起三年前第一次炒币亏掉的两万，想起去年追高BTC被套的三万，想起所有嘲笑他炒币的亲戚朋友。

他深吸一口气，全部卖出。

到账的那一刻，他坐在工位上愣了整整五分钟。然后他打开微信，给老婆转了十万，备注写着：给女儿报钢琴课，剩下的存定期。

老婆秒回：你中彩票了？

老陈笑了笑，没回复。他把手机翻过去扣在桌上，窗外深圳的阳光正好，他忽然觉得，这辈子的运气可能都用在这一把了。

后来牛来又涨到了零点零七二，又跌回了零点零五。但老陈已经不在乎了。他删掉了币安APP，周末带女儿去试听了一节钢琴课。

小女孩按下第一个琴键的时候，老陈觉得，这比任何百倍币都好听。

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Have to Be Able to Afford Losses to Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down only 20%, a few winning trades can get you back. By contrast, if you go all in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re basically done for.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
must not exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scale Out to Take Profits: How to Lock In Gains and Let Profits Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because a stop-loss cuts fear, while taking profits cuts greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here’s the scale-out profit-taking strategy I’ve been using.

[Three stages] Stage one: At the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), reduce your position by a third and lock in some profits.
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and my mindset immediately changes. Stage two: At the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), take off another third. Stage three: Let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

[Why this works] Close your entire position too early and you’ll kick yourself; hold the whole thing and you’ll often watch your profits evaporate.

ETH has turned from falling to rising, up +0.43% at 2261.93. But the truly informative signal isn't this green candle—it's the 8h funding rate flipping from negative back to +0.0004%, just 4% of the full 0.01% benchmark. Shorts have stopped paying rent; longs haven't started paying yet. This isn't an attack—it's open ground after a retreat.

First, look at the funding-rate structure. +0.0004% annualizes to about 0.44%, nowhere near even a fraction of the benchmark. If this were a genuine breakout, perpetuals would move first: funding would at least return to around 0.01% and hold there for two or three settlement cycles. It has only returned to 4%, which suggests that short covering pushed the price up, but new longs aren't chasing with leverage. In plain English: selling pressure has eased, but buyers haven't shown up yet.

Next, look at the mismatch between open interest and trading volume. Open interest is 5.357 billion USDT, while 24h trading volume is 2.668 billion, for a turnover ratio of about 0.5. High open interest and low turnover mean positions are sticky, not that new money is actively rotating in and out. The price is up just 0.43%, trading volume hasn't expanded, and there's no aggressive bid in spot markets either. This combination looks more like existing positions being adjusted than fresh capital entering.

The third dimension is account structure. Long accounts make up 71.8%—retail accounts are clearly skewed long—but funding is only 4% of the benchmark. Account numbers are tilted long, but notional capital isn't: large accounts are either neutral or still hedging. This divergence matters: it shows that leveraged longs in perpetuals aren't crowded, so the mechanical squeeze pressure on the downside isn't as great as you might think. But conversely, if the price stops rising, these small accounts will be the first layer of fuel for stop-loss selling. The crowd is on one side, the money on the other—this structure is especially prone to false breakouts.

There are two news-related sources of noise to filter out. Binance has resumed withdrawals of BTC, ETH, USDT, and other assets across 15 networks, and routed all withdrawals through PoR addresses. This removes tail risk at the exchange; it isn't direct buying pressure. It won't make ETH rise another 5%, but it may give some funds that had been sitting in stablecoins due to withdrawal uncertainty one less reason to stay on the sidelines. The other story is the FBI attributing a $6 billion theft to North Korea's TraderTraitor. That's a structural supply overhang, not a pricing factor for today, but it weighs on the narrative's upside. Don't mistake a rebound for a trend reversal.

So my view is straightforward: 2261.93 is a recovery, not a reversal. There are two confirmation signals: funding must rise above the 0.01% benchmark and stay there for two or three settlement cycles, while open interest expands alongside up days and 24h trading volume tops 3 billion. Until both happen, +0.43% can only be called a vacuum rebound after short covering. The risk-reward for going long isn't in chasing this green candle; it's in waiting for a pullback while funding remains positive. Shorts shouldn't step in at a level where funding is only 4% of the benchmark—the structure isn't offering enough compensation. Keep some room in your position: in this kind of funding vacuum, it's easy to get swept in both directions.

#ETH #币安 #Crypto

再看持仓和成交的错位。持仓量 53.57 亿 USDT，24h 成交 26.68 亿，换手率约 0.5。高持仓、低换手，意味着仓位是粘住的，不是新资金在反复换手。价格只涨 0.43%，成交额没有放大，现货端也没有看到 aggressive bid。这种组合更像存量仓位调整，不是增量资金进场。

第三个维度是账户结构。多头账户占比 71.8%，散户账户明显偏多，但费率只有基准的 4%。账户数在多头，名义资金却没在多头——大账户要么中性，要么还在对冲。这个背离很关键：它说明永续端的杠杆多头并不拥挤，向下的机械性挤兑压力没有想象中那么大；但反过来，一旦价格停涨，这批小账户会成为止损盘的第一层燃料。人群站在一边，钱站在另一边，这种结构最容易出假突破。

事件面有两个噪音需要过滤。币安恢复 15 条网络的 BTC、ETH、USDT 等提币，并把提币全部切到 PoR 地址，这拆掉的是交易所尾部风险，不是直接买盘。它不会让 ETH 多涨 5%，但会让一部分原本因为提币不确定性而停在稳定币里的资金少一个观望理由。另一条是 FBI 把 60 亿美元窃案归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor，这是结构性供给阴影，不是今天的定价因子，但它压着叙事上限，别把反弹当成趋势反转。

所以我的判断很直接：2261.93 这个位置是修复，不是反转。确认信号有两个——费率回到 0.01% 基准上方并连续两三个结算周期不塌，同时上涨日的持仓量同步扩张、24h 成交额站上 30 亿。这两个没出现之前，+0.43% 只能定义为空头回补后的真空反弹。做多的赔率不在追这根阳线，在等回踩时费率仍然持正；做空的别在费率只有基准 4% 的位置去接，结构没给你足够的补偿。仓位留余地，这种费率真空里最容易被双向扫。

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place Your Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you use one. Too close, and you'll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It's simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might end up right in a cluster of other traders' stops.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the market structure becomes invalid: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if the price breaks this level, it means there's evidence that I was wrong.
Adjust your position size based on the stop distance: the farther away the stop, the smaller the position, so the loss on any single trade stays at

【Volume’s going nowhere; an itchy trigger finger won’t help】

I’ve been watching ETH closely these past few days. Around 2205 feels like a net, while 2320 is like a ceiling overhead. The price is stuck in between: it’s barely moved in 24 hours, but it’s down nearly 4% over 7 days, and trading volume is on the low side. It’s not that nobody’s watching the market—everyone’s waiting for someone else to show their hand first. I admit, this kind of sideways action makes it especially tempting to jump in. Even knowing a breakout could be a fakeout, I can’t help thinking: could this finally be my turn?

What really made me stop and take notice was the FBI confirming North Korea’s involvement in that $6 billion Binance hack and urging the DeFi community to block the associated BTC, ETH, and SOL addresses. Chainalysis also said the number of addresses will continue to grow. What does this mean in practice? The first things affected will be address tracking, transaction reviews, and compliance coordination among DeFi projects. On-chain anonymity won’t simply disappear, but the gates through which funds flow will get tighter. The business logic checks out—but will the market immediately reward ETH for it? I’m not sure, and I won’t try to spin a security incident into bullish news.

So here’s where I’m stuck: with volume this low, does sideways trading mean nobody’s willing to step in, or are the coins changing hands? I’m watching both 2205 and 2320, but I won’t pretend I can see through the market. How are you feeling right now? Are you getting itchy to make a move?

1. Price Trend Analysis

As of the early hours of November 2 Beijing time, Ethereum was trading at $2,258, up 0.39% over the past 24 hours. On the hourly chart, ETH gradually fell from $2,271 to an intraday low of $2,254 over the past five hours, before trading in a narrow range around $2,258.

Ethereum’s recent price movements have been influenced by multiple factors. On the one hand, after Binance restored withdrawal services, liquidity bottlenecks at major exchanges eased, and withdrawals of ETH on both the mainnet and Layer 2 networks were fully restored. This helped push the price back up to $2,276 in the short term. On the other hand, the Moscow Exchange announced that it would open retail trading of Ethereum on December 1, providing region-specific support for the market.

However, the structural pressures facing Ethereum should not be overlooked. Spot ETFs have recorded net outflows for 23 consecutive trading days, and this sustained institutional selling has weighed heavily on prices. The current price has fallen below the 99-period exponential moving average at $2,275, making the signs of technical weakness fairly clear.

2. Technical Indicator Analysis

As for moving averages, the 7-period MA is at $2,265, the 25-period MA is at $2,265, and the 99-period MA is at $2,273. The price is trading below all major moving averages, confirming a bearish alignment. Exponential moving averages are also signaling bearishness: the 7-period EMA is at $2,263, below the 25-period EMA at $2,263.

The RSI readings show that the 6-period RSI is at 33.35, already in the lower range; the 12-period RSI is at 44.06, and the 24-period RSI is at 48.29. 以太坊市场深度分析：技术面偏空但中期信号转多

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十一月二日凌晨，以太坊报价两千两百五十八美元，过去二十四小时上涨百分之零点三九。从小时K线观察，ETH在过去五个小时内从两千两百七十一美元逐步回落至两千两百五十四美元的日内低点，随后在两千两百五十八美元附近窄幅震荡。

以太坊近期的走势受到多重因素影响。一方面，币安恢复提币服务后，主流交易所的流动性瓶颈得到缓解，ETH在主网和二层网络上的提币功能全面恢复，短期内推动了价格向两千两百七十六美元反弹。另一方面，莫斯科交易所宣布将于十二月一日开放以太坊零售交易，为市场提供了区域性的利好支撑。

然而，以太坊面临的结构性压力不容忽视。现货ETF已经连续二十三个交易日出现净流出，这种持续的机构抛售行为对价格构成了沉重的上方压力。当前价格已经跌破了九十九周期指数移动均线两千两百七十五美元，技术面转弱的信号较为明确。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七周期均线报两千两百六十五美元，二十五周期均线报两千两百六十五美元，九十九周期均线报两千两百七十三美元。价格运行在所有主要均线下方，空头排列格局已经确立。指数移动均线同样呈现空头信号，七周期EMA报两千两百六十三美元，已经低于二十五周期EMA的两千两百六十三美元。

RSI指标显示，六周期RSI报三十三点三五，已经进入偏低区域，十二周期RSI报四十四点零六，二十四周期RSI报四十八点二九。短期超卖信号明显，但尚未达到极端超卖水平。KDJ指标中，K值三十六点四五，D值四十五点一九，J值十八点九七，J值已经深入超卖区域。

MACD方面，MACD线报一点三五，信号线报三点一七，柱状图为负一点八二且持续扩大，空头动能仍在释放中。不过，随机RSI已经跌至零点二七的极端水平，这是一个非常强烈的超卖信号。威廉指标报负七十九点四零，同样处于超卖区域。

值得关注的是，尽管短期技术指标偏空，但十五个量化因子中有九个发出做多信号，占比百分之六十。复合指标当前显示做多信号，数值为一点二二，整体胜率高达百分之八十二点九八，其中做多信号的胜率更是达到百分之九十点四八。这意味着从中期角度来看，市场可能正在酝酿一次反转。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临的最大风险来自机构层面的持续撤离。现货ETF连续二十三天的净流出记录，反映出传统金融机构对以太坊短期前景的悲观预期。同时，朝鲜黑客组织将大量窃取资产转换为ETH的行为，也引发了市场对潜在制裁和黑名单风险的担忧。

不过，链上数据显示，近期出现了多笔超过六百万至七百万USDT的大额买入，虽然未能推动价格突破上方阻力，但表明仍有资金在逢低吸纳。超级趋势指标维持在两千两百四十九美元附近，当前价格仍然位于超级趋势线上方，中期支撑结构尚未被破坏。

从波动率角度来看，十四周期ATR报七点四八，五日标准差报三点八五，波动率处于相对温和的水平。布林带下轨约在两千两百五十九美元，当前价格恰好运行在这一位置附近，如果能够有效企稳，有望迎来一波技术性反弹。

综合来看，以太坊短期面临技术面和情绪面的双重压力，但中期量化信号已经转向做多，极端超卖指标也暗示底部可能正在形成。建议关注两千两百五十美元的关键支撑位，以及两千两百七十五美元的阻力位。

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

translatedData.subTitle:
Last time, we talked about how funding rates work. Today, we’ll look at how to use them as a sentiment gauge.

[State 1: Funding rates remain strongly positive] This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a top, and a sharp drop from a “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. I’m not telling you to immediately
shorting; rather, be extra cautious about chasing longs at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates remain negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who needed to get out has already done so, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past started at times like this.

“ETH long positions have topped 380,000, more than 4 times August’s figure. Everyone’s betting on a rebound.”

This was posted last night by an account with 140,000 followers. It got 16,000 views, and the replies were full of “traders are loading.”

Let me ask one thing first: Which exchange? Spot margin or perpetuals? What share of total open interest? The original post didn’t mention any of that. A number with no context isn’t a signal—it’s just an excuse to believe what you want.

Even if the data is real, the conclusion is backwards. With longs piled up like this, at the current price of around $2,260, that’s roughly $860 million in long positions sitting out there. The 200-day moving average is down at $2,150–$2,160, and ETH dipped to $2,170 just two days ago. If you were a market maker looking at that huge pile of stop-losses and liquidations below, would you pump the price for you—or go sweep those levels first?

Everyone watched those ETH long whales on Hyperliquid get wiped out last week. A crowded trade is never the safe trade—it’s just the popular one.

I’ve seen the inverse head-and-shoulders, the falling wedge, and the calls for $3,000. The patterns may be there, but I don’t buy the logic that “the more longs there are, the more bullish it is.” If you ask me, if you really want to go long, waiting until this pile of leverage gets flushed out before entering would feel a lot better than loading up now.

#ETH

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What is the funding rate? Why do longs have to pay shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is a payment between longs and shorts
that they make to each other. The exchange just collects and distributes the money; it doesn’t keep any of it.

【Mechanism】Perpetual contracts have no settlement date, so how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? That’s what the funding rate is for:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (sellers are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
The money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn't happen in an instant; it's a process. Understand how it works, and you'll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, with 10x leverage, that's 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts sending “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

Unlike the money stolen from Ripple and Binance last time, North Korea isn’t rushing to cash out. Instead, it’s putting the stolen funds into “diversified investments”—an unprecedented move.

Why does this news matter?
This incident shows how wild the combination of crypto laundering and geopolitics can get. North Korea isn’t afraid of regulators, and it doesn’t care whether it can make money from these funds—as long as they’re safe. Nineteen wallets suggest it may be treating Bitcoin as a strategic reserve, or playing an extremely long-term “ambush game.” This is different from traditional money laundering: stolen coins used to be quickly converted into cash, but North Korea now seems to be building a “digital gold reserve.” This also shows that if a major player steals crypto in the future, they may simply dump the stolen funds into cold wallets, making them exponentially harder for regulators to recover.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this incident reinforces crypto’s status as a “lawless frontier.” It benefits players like North Korea who aren’t afraid of regulators, while undermining regulators’ confidence. If North Korea really is treating these funds as reserves, it could suddenly sell them off in large quantities at some point in the future, which would deal a devastating blow to BTC and ETH prices. A similar historical example: after Bitfinex was hacked in 2017, the hackers split the funds into small amounts and moved them over a long period, and most of the funds were ultimately unrecoverable. North Korea’s approach this time is even more discreet. If the funds remain frozen for longer, the recovery rate could be even lower.

💡 In short: This incident means crypto has become a “haven for dirty money,” but in the long run, North Korea’s funds may be stuck there forever. If a new dark-web currency emerges in the future that makes wallet addresses impossible to trace, this kind of theft may become completely unstoppable.

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。
