translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures contract, you'll be asked to choose “isolated” or “cross” margin. Many beginners just pick one without thinking and end up paying dearly.

【Cross margin】Your entire account balance is used as margin. The advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get wiped out;
The downside: in an extreme market, your losses could wipe out your entire account. It's putting all your eggs in one basket.
The positions support each other in the same basket.

【Isolated margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My advice】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you aren't yet able to assess the worst-case scenario for a single bad trade

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

After the first phase reopened 15 chains, everyone was really focused on one question: Is money flowing out? Early this morning, Binance released its first official figures.

First, the latest numbers. Over the nine and a half hours from 14:00 to 23:30 Beijing time on Nov. 1, Binance processed $4.649 billion in withdrawals, while $1.01 billion was deposited over the same period, resulting in a net outflow of about $3.64 billion. By Binance’s own calculations, that represents 2.1% of its $171 billion in assets under management, based on its Proof of Reserves data from Oct. 28. The company said withdrawals had fallen after an initial surge and were “stabilizing as expected,” while deposits remained “substantial.” A spokesperson later added that withdrawals had “declined sharply and are returning to normal expected levels of on-chain activity.”

Let’s separate what’s new from what isn’t: the new information is this first-day flow report and the official assessment that the surge has passed. The previous figures remain unchanged: replenishment is still about 95%, roughly 5% is made up of less-liquid tokens, there is still no timeline for the second phase, and the remaining networks and assets are still undergoing checks one by one. So this isn’t “everything is back to normal”; it’s “the first stress test since the first phase reopened.”

My take: $3.64 billion sounds alarming, but against a $171 billion base, it’s 2.1%. And Binance says the peak has passed—at least through 23:30, the narrative of sustained, panic-driven outflows hasn’t been borne out. Still, two points need scrutiny: first, the denominator for the 2.1% figure is an old snapshot from Oct. 28, not a real-time figure after the outflow. Second, there are two versions of the Proof of Reserves timeline. Binance’s post says the updated report will be available “tomorrow” (which, based on the post date, means Nov. 2), while the earlier version said the full zero-knowledge proof would be released on Nov. 3. We’ll have to wait for the official release to see which date—and which report—holds. Don’t treat either as set in stone yet.

Price snapshot before publication (cross-checked against two sources; 0.06% discrepancy): $BTC around $78,131, up about 0.64% over 24 hours; $ETH around $2,270, up about 0.72% over 24 hours. The broader market hasn’t taken off on the news, so don’t mistake “withdrawals are available” for “prices are going up.”

Risk reminder: These flow figures are self-reported by Binance. The 24-hour figure from third-party DefiLlama shows a net outflow of about $4.05 billion (the time windows differ, so the direction is consistent, but the figures shouldn’t be directly compared). Withdrawals may still be delayed or fail during peak periods. Always verify the address and network before withdrawing, and make sure you select the right chain.

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1,000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage is when the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U in initial capital and use 10x leverage, you’re effectively controlling
a 1,000U position. If the price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your initial capital; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your initial capital—note that the loss is calculated based on the total position you borrowed to open.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the price moves against you by about 10%, your initial capital is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that it takes a 10% drop to lose everything—a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact price level also depends on the margin ratio).

I disconnected my wallet from the website… Did I revoke its permissions?

In Web3 apps, connecting your wallet to a website is different from granting it permission to spend your tokens. Clicking “Disconnect” does not automatically revoke spending approvals recorded on the blockchain.

Hypothetical example: You want to swap 50 units of an ERC-20 token, but the approval window asks for unlimited permission. You are not approving only the swap amount; you are granting the contract permission to spend that token from your wallet, within the allowance.

If the contract is malicious or gets exploited, the rest of your holdings of that token may be at risk. Approval for one token does not grant permission to withdraw all your other coins.

Before approving, check the authorized spender’s address, the token, and the spending limit. Set it to the required amount whenever possible. Review old approvals using a blockchain explorer or a trusted tool, and revoke any you no longer need.

Revoking is an on-chain transaction and may require a fee. It does not recover stolen funds or fix a leaked recovery phrase. Never enter that phrase on any website to check approvals.

Source: https://revoke.cash/learn/faq

Disclaimer: This is educational and analytical content, not a recommendation to buy or sell, nor a guarantee of profit.

#WalletSecurity #Web3 #الكريبتو_بالأرقام #ETH

content:
فصلت المحفظة عن الموقع… هل ألغيت صلاحياته؟

في تطبيقات Web3، ربط المحفظة بالموقع يختلف عن منحه إذن إنفاق رموزك. الضغط على «فصل الاتصال» لا يلغي تلقائيًا أذونات الإنفاق المسجلة على الشبكة.

مثال افتراضي: تريد مبادلة 50 وحدة من رمز ERC-20، لكن نافذة الموافقة تطلب إذنًا غير محدود. أنت لا توافق على مبلغ المبادلة وحده؛ بل تمنح العقد صلاحية إنفاق هذا الرمز من محفظتك ضمن الإذن.

إذا كان العقد خبيثًا أو تعرض للاستغلال، فقد تكون بقية حيازتك من الرمز معرضة للخطر. ولا يعني الإذن لرمز واحد صلاحية سحب كل العملات الأخرى.

قبل الموافقة، افحص عنوان الجهة المخوّلة والرمز وحد الإنفاق، وحدده بالمبلغ المطلوب متى أمكن. راجع الأذونات القديمة عبر مستكشف الشبكة أو أداة موثوقة، وألغِ ما لم تعد تحتاجه.

الإلغاء معاملة على الشبكة وقد يتطلب رسومًا. وهو لا يعيد أموالًا سُرقت، ولا يصلح تسريب عبارة الاسترداد. لا تدخل تلك العبارة في أي موقع لفحص الأذونات.

The 11:00 close moved above 78,500, then fell back below it by midday: the breakout counts, but it hasn’t held yet

This morning I wrote “higher highs, breakout unconfirmed.” By midday, we got our answer: the 11:00 one-hour candle closed at 78,634, the first close above 78,500, on roughly 53.48 million USDT in volume—2.6 times the roughly 20.64 million on the 10:00 candle. It didn’t quietly sneak above the level; it closed above it on increased volume. At the 11:00 close, the morning’s “unconfirmed” call was overturned.

But don’t rush to call the breakout confirmed. The 12:00 candle opened at 78,634 and only reached a high of 78,724 before pulling back steadily. The midday price is now 78,432, back below 78,500—so it moved above the level only to be pushed straight back under it. My take: the close counts, but holding above the level doesn’t yet. A single close above it only proves that the bulls managed to reclaim the level this time. Whether they can hold it depends on whether this candle and the next one also close above 78,500.

Comparing with the other two points from this morning: there’s been no breakdown below. The 24-hour low is still around 77,620, with 77,000 a long way off, so this is still a “fight for the level,” not a “turn toward weakness.” ETH is at 2,293 at midday, up about 1.1% over 24 hours; its 11:00 close was 2,309, so it’s following the move, not leading it. And price hasn’t gone far to the upside either: the 11:00 high of 78,878 is still today’s high, and 80,000 remains a fair way off. Don’t start calling the next stop just because of one close.

Altcoins haven’t caused any trouble for the majors by midday either. SOPH is still at the top of the gainers list, up about 19% over 24 hours, but no new catalyst for today has been confirmed twice yet. The existing backdrop is still the old bearish news about the November 30 mainnet shutdown. I’m not chasing a top gainer like this. BEAMX is still holding above 0.0053, Niulai still hasn’t closed above 0.07222, and XPL and LSK remain weak. Structurally, they’re still moving independently, with no second engine capable of driving the broader market.

From this afternoon into the European session, the variables worth watching aren’t on the chart: at 23:00 Beijing time tonight, the US October ISM Manufacturing PMI will be released. September’s reading was 54.5; this is the October report. Also, according to secondary reports updated on November 1, Binance’s full proof of reserves has been pushed to November 3, while the October 31 snapshot has already been posted. Neither of those dates has arrived yet, so this midday pullback is probably just the market waiting on them.

My trading rule is simple: I’ll only talk about further upside if the close holds above 78,500. If this candle or the next one closes below 78,500, I’ll treat the 11:00 close above it as a brief move through resistance. If price falls back below 77,620, I’ll reassess for weakness. At the current price, I’m not chasing.

Risk warning: This is only my personal market commentary, not investment advice. Price can move either way and prove me wrong. Set your own position size, and don’t place trades based on a post.

translatedData.content:
Trading discipline | Position size should contract as your account grows—not get bigger just because you're making money

BTC is currently around 78,500, with a slight intraday rebound, but resistance above 80,000 remains. The impulse to “increase your position again after a small rally” often undermines discipline more easily than a one-way decline.

A few reminders I keep coming back to:

1) As your account grows, the same percentage drawdown hurts more in absolute terms—so your position size should contract relative to your account, not scale up linearly.
2) Set your stop-loss before entering, not after a loss becomes painful. Changing your stop-loss means you effectively have no stop-loss.
3) A rebound doesn’t mean the trend has reversed. Until the structure is confirmed, treat it as an “observation position”—don’t bet on a narrative with your entire account.
4) Review your plan at most once a day. Don’t stare at the 1-minute chart and change it three times.

Risk management isn’t about not trading; it’s about making sure you can still trade next week and next month. For informational purposes only; not investment advice.

#BTC #ETH #交易纪律 #RiskManagement

交易纪律｜仓位随规模收敛，不是越赚越敢加

translatedData.content:
In the Binance theft of approximately $6.3 billion, what truly determines the scale of the losses is not the speed of the attack, but whether the assets can be “frozen.” My view is that stablecoin freezes can intercept some of the funds, but they cannot change the fact that the final losses remain highly uncertain. Equating “approximately $3 billion frozen” with “approximately $3 billion recovered” is a misreading.

First, the facts. On-chain records show that the attacker used the EIP-7702 authorization mechanism to have Binance 14’s hot wallet execute batch transfers, moving approximately 167,000 ETH and USDT worth approximately $1.615 billion on the Ethereum network. Abnormal transfers were also seen on networks including Bitcoin, TRON, and Solana. Binance’s preliminary estimate put the amount affected at approximately $6.3 billion, and it said approximately $3 billion had been frozen. According to Reuters, Tether froze nearly $1.57 billion, Circle froze more than $800 million, and Ripple froze approximately $200 million. The PANews dashboard put the total at approximately $2.579 billion based on contract blacklists, reflecting differences in statistical scope compared with Binance’s figures.

The difference in mechanisms is key to understanding this incident. Tether and Circle can freeze the USDT and USDC they issue, but they cannot freeze BTC or ETH in the same way. The attacker has already sold or exchanged approximately $431 million in assets through decentralized exchanges and deposited approximately $60 million in USDT to Aave to borrow 19,762 ETH. This suggests that once funds are converted into assets beyond the control of their issuers, freezing tools no longer work. The stolen assets may also enter lending systems, creating new risk exposure.

The reserve situation is also worth monitoring. CoinDesk’s analysis of the October 1 proof of reserves showed that Binance 14 was one of the publicly listed reserve wallets, holding approximately 89,500 ETH and 1.26 billion USDT at the time. Its estimate suggested that ETH reserve coverage may have fallen from 100% to approximately 94%. This is not evidence of insolvency, but it raises the question of how quickly reserves can be replenished. Binance has pledged that losses will be covered by the SAFU Fund and company funds, and that it will update its proof of reserves after repairs are completed.

In my view, three indicators should be watched next: whether balances at frozen addresses continue to change, whether Binance’s new proof of reserves restores full coverage, and whether withdrawals resume as promised. If the amount frozen grows and a new reserve snapshot shows replenishment, confidence that the losses are manageable will strengthen. If funds continue to be exchanged and dispersed while reserve data remains unupdated, uncertainty will rise. This article does not constitute investment advice.

$BTC

#BTC #ETH #SOL #USDT

PANews (originally published 11-02 10:02 Beijing time)

content:
币安约63亿美元被盗事件中，真正决定损失规模的不是攻击速度，而是资产能否被“冻住”。我的判断是：稳定币冻结能截住一部分资金，但无法改变最终损失仍高度不确定这一事实，把“已冻结约30亿美元”等同于“追回约30亿美元”是误读。

先看事实。链上记录显示，攻击者利用EIP-7702授权机制让Binance 14热钱包执行批量转账，以太坊网络上转出约16.7万枚ETH和价值约16.15亿美元的USDT，比特币、波场、Solana等网络也出现异常转移。币安初步估计影响金额约63亿美元，并称已有约30亿美元被冻结。据路透社报道，Tether冻结近15.7亿美元，Circle冻结超8亿美元，Ripple冻结约2亿美元；PANews看板按合约黑名单统计约25.79亿美元，与币安口径存在统计范围差异。

机制差异是理解这件事的关键。Tether、Circle能冻结自己发行的USDT、USDC，却无法用同样方式冻结BTC、ETH。攻击者已通过去中心化交易所出售或兑换约4.31亿美元资产，并向Aave存入约6000万美元USDT借出19,762枚ETH。据此推断，资金一旦换成发行方控制不到的资产，冻结工具就失效了，被盗资产还可能进入借贷体系形成新的风险敞口。

储备层面同样值得跟踪。CoinDesk对10月1日储备证明的分析显示，Binance 14是公开列出的储备钱包之一，当时持有约8.95万枚ETH和12.6亿枚USDT；其估算ETH储备覆盖率可能从100%降至约94%。这不是资不抵债的证据，但提出了补足速度的问题。币安承诺由SAFU基金和公司资金承担损失，并在修复后更新储备证明。

我的观察是，接下来应盯三个指标：冻结地址余额是否继续变化、币安新储备证明能否恢复足额覆盖、提现恢复进度是否兑现。若冻结规模扩大且储备快照补足，损失可控的判断会增强；若资金持续兑换分散、储备数据迟迟不更新，不确定性就会上升。本文不构成投资建议。

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#ETH #Gas #BTC

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are the Fuel Costs of a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay Gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring funds, trading, running a
smart contract) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who execute those computations.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more everyone rushes to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing Gas fees. So experienced users
have a habit: they choose late at night or quiet market periods for on-chain operations. The same operations can cost half as much.

translatedData.content:
First, what does a DEX aggregator do?
An aggregator generally doesn’t hold liquidity itself; it simply handles routing and connects to underlying DEX pools to complete swaps.
An aggregator may also swap through intermediate tokens in multiple steps, such as swapping A for ETH first, then ETH for B.
Before approving a token, confirm that the contract you’re approving is the router contract officially published by the aggregator.
When swapping through an aggregator on Ethereum, pay Gas with $ETH ; $1INCH is 1inch’s governance token.

#ETH

content:
先问一句：DEX 聚合器是做什么的？
聚合器本身一般不持有流动性，只是负责路由，对接底层 DEX 的池子来完成兑换。
聚合器还会经过中间代币分多步兑换，比如先将 A 换成 ETH，再把 ETH 换成 B。
授权代币之前确认授权的合约是否为聚合器官方公布的路由合约。
以太坊上用聚合器兑换，Gas 用 $ETH 付；$1INCH 是 1inch 的治理代币。

Your wallet has no ETH. Can you still transfer tokens on Ethereum?
The Pectra upgrade in May 2025 introduced EIP-7702, which lets existing externally owned accounts delegate code execution to a contract.
Here’s what matters: when choosing a smart contract wallet, check who controls the recovery mechanism, whether the code has been audited, and who holds the upgrade permissions.
With a Paymaster, you can complete Ethereum transactions even if your wallet has no $ETH ; a third party covers the Gas fees.
Don’t invest with borrowed money. It can put you under pressure and lead to bad decisions.

📐 Technical Principles｜Account Abstraction
· Definition: Ethereum originally had two types of accounts: externally owned accounts (EOAs) controlled by private keys, and contract accounts controlled by code. Only externally owned accounts can initiate transactions.
· Why it matters: Account abstraction changes the rules for “how an account can be used” from being hard-coded into the protocol to being determined by contracts. Signing and payment methods can both be designed as needed.
· Practical tip: When a wallet asks you to delegate your account to a contract, be sure to check the contract address and its source. Reject requests from unfamiliar websites.

Guys, this is something we really need to understand: account abstraction!
The Pectra upgrade in May 2025 added EIP-7702, which lets existing externally owned accounts delegate code execution to a contract.
Account abstraction means changing the rules for “how an account can be used” from being hard-coded into the protocol to being defined by contracts. Signing and payment methods can be designed as needed.
With a Paymaster, you can make Ethereum transactions even if your wallet has no $ETH , with a third party covering the Gas. Currently 2311.42.
Save this and take a closer look later 👇

兄弟们，这个必须搞明白：账户抽象！
2025 年 5 月的 Pectra 升级加入了 EIP-7702，现有的外部账户可以设置把代码执行委托给某个合约。
账户抽象是把“怎样才能动用账户”的规则从协议写死改为由合约决定，签名方式、付费方式都可以按需设计。

The market is currently in a phase of repairing confidence in the safety narrative. The short-term negative impact of the hack has been partly absorbed, but institutional ETF funds continue to flow out. title: $ETH｜Binance 事件后的链上“二次分配”：验证者、套利者与攻击者的三方博弈
subTitle:
Bitquery 10月30日调查显示，在 63亿美元 Binance 黑客事件后的链上混乱中，收益并未停留在攻击者手中，而是被基础设施和套利资本重新分配：

核心数据（据 Bitquery，待多方交叉验证）
• 验证者捕获了与交易相关的近 3,000万美元支付的大部分；
• 攻击者试图阻止稳定币发行方冻结被盗资金，因不利交易损失约 1.19亿美元；
• 交易公司和自动机器人利用价格缺口，扣除成本后赚取约 6,000万美元；
• 并非所有机器人都盈利，部分支付的交易费用超过交易收益。

机制解读
攻击者为了转移/保护被盗资产，被迫在流动性薄、滑点大的环境中快速交易，稳定币冻结预期又加剧了对手方风险。这制造了短时价格缺口和区块空间争夺：验证者通过交易排序与优先费捕获价值，套利者赚取价差，但高Gas、失败交易和反向波动会让部分机器人亏损。本质是安全事件外溢为 MEV 与流动性事件。

对 ETH 的含义
• 短期：链上拥堵和优先费上升，验证者收入脉冲式增加，但不构成 ETH 基本面重估；
• 中期：事件强化稳定币发行方冻结能力和合规干预预期，DeFi 对手方风险溢价可能上升；
• 结构：MEV 收益集中与机器人亏损并存，说明“套利”不是无风险，执行成本和时机决定盈亏。

结论
这是一次攻击者亏损、验证者和套利者获利的链上再分配，不是市场普涨信号。对 ETH 偏中性：短期利好验证者收入与链上活动，长期取决于安全与合规外溢是否抑制风险偏好。数据来自 #Bitquery 调查，需以官方和链上独立核验为准。

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Flat Is a Position Too—and It’s the One Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, entering and exiting positions every day,
until fees and volatility grind away their capital.

In reality, staying flat is the only position with zero losses. Stay flat when you don’t understand the market,
Staying flat when bulls and bears are battling it out, and staying flat after a string of losing trades—money saved in these three moments
can add up to more than most trades earn.

We’ve all heard the hunting analogy, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. If you have capital on hand, you’ll have bullets when an opportunity comes along. Hold on to your bullets.

Thinking about it, it’s kind of funny. Last night, while I was asleep, I answered the phone and heard the voice on the other end say, “It’s blown! Binance has been hacked for $3.5 billion. Ethereum on-chain has already climbed to $2,700. Funds are still being transferred out, and they’re continuously buying Ethereum.”

I thought I was dreaming.

I had a cigarette, and only then realized it really had been hacked. It wasn’t $3.5 billion—the funds flowing out of Binance’s hot wallet were

$4 billion?

$4.5 billion?

$5 billion?

………The question slowly formed in my mind: What was Binance’s security team doing? Where were its private keys? The hackers kept moving the funds out all night. Things were chaotic on-chain, like a ferocious tiger charging into a flock of sheep, sending them scattering in all directions.

In the short term, sentiment has stabilized, and prices have steadied too. Looking long term, though, confidence has been lost. Before bed, I’d taken one last look at Hype, excitedly getting ready for the market to use Hype to gain entry into America’s top-tier circles.

I’d even talked with friends about how, although I could see Hype’s potential when I bought it, I never dreamed it could break into America’s next-generation financial infrastructure.

The post Musk reposted last night came from the Soros camp, which is aligned with the current Federal Reserve chair and the U.S. Treasury Secretary.

translatedData.content:
EIP-7702 is not a vulnerability in itself, but it condenses the risks of private keys—which were previously spread out—into a complete authorization of funds that can be triggered with a single signature. Whether this assessment holds depends on whether wallets and signing infrastructure impose sufficient constraints on “delegation targets.”

First, let’s lay out the facts. According to content from Decrypt compiled by PANews, EIP-7702 was activated with the Pectra upgrade in May 2025. It allows externally owned accounts to temporarily borrow smart contract code while retaining their original addresses and funds; the delegated code gains full access to the wallet’s funds. The article also notes that the specification explicitly warns that delegated code has “unrestricted access to the account,” and says there is no secure way for wallets to provide an interface for directly signing this kind of authorization.

The Binance incident is an extreme example of this mechanism. According to the same source, on October 29, 2026, attackers transferred approximately $6.4 billion from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains. Both TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed the theft to the North Korean hacking group TraderTraitor. On Ethereum, the attackers used EIP-7702 delegation to turn a hot wallet into an asset aggregator, and had pre-signed 50 authorizations. Chainalysis said that an operational wallet funded through Tornado Cash submitted these signed authorizations. TRM Labs also said that funds on the other nine chains were transferred out through ordinary signed transactions, suggesting that the problem was more likely in Binance’s hot wallet signing infrastructure than in the Ethereum protocol itself.

My observation is that EIP-7702’s batching, gas sponsorship, and permission downgrading offer real benefits, but the benefits and risks are asymmetric: permission downgrading requires deliberate design, whereas full access for delegated code is the default effect. For ordinary users, this means that the consequences of “signing an authorization once” could far exceed those of a single transaction. For exchanges, if the signing process for a hot wallet is compromised, the potential losses from a single point of failure are magnified.

Based on this, three things are worth monitoring: whether wallets restrict or hide EIP-7702 delegation by default; whether exchanges migrate hot wallets to multisig or capped accounts; and whether any proposals emerge to tighten delegation permissions. If these safeguards are implemented, the urgency of the assessment above will diminish. If the source material provides no relevant updates, however, these should be treated as questions requiring verification, not as established facts. This article does not constitute investment advice.

$ETH

#ETH #钱包安全 #CryptoSecurity

PANews (originally published 11-02 at 09:00 Beijing time)
https://www.panewslab.com/zh/articles/01a1963e-173f-75b8-b0ca-4d77f7e159c7

content:
EIP-7702本身不是漏洞，但它把原本分散的私钥风险，压缩成了一次签名就能触发的资金完全授权。这个判断能否成立，取决于钱包和签名基础设施有没有为“委托目标”设置足够约束。

先把事实摆清。据PANews编译Decrypt的内容，EIP-7702于2025年5月随Pectra升级激活，允许外部拥有账户在保留原地址和资金的同时，临时借用智能合约代码；被委托的代码将获得对该钱包资金的完全访问权限。该文还提到，规范明确警告委托代码拥有“对账户无限制的访问权限”，并称没有安全方式让钱包提供直接签署此类授权的界面。

币安事件是这套机制的极端样本。据同一素材，2026年10月29日，攻击者在10条区块链上从币安钱包转走约64亿美元，TRM Labs和Chainalysis均将盗窃归因于朝鲜黑客组织TraderTraitor；在以太坊网络上，攻击者利用EIP-7702委托将一个热钱包变成资产归集器，并预先签署了50份授权。Chainalysis称，一个通过Tornado Cash获取资金的操作钱包提交了这些已签名授权。TRM Labs还表示，其余9条链上的资金通过常规签名转账流出，说明问题更可能出在币安热钱包签名基础设施，而非以太坊协议本身。

我的观察是，EIP-7702的批处理、Gas赞助和权限降级都是真实收益，但收益与风险不对称：权限降级需要主动设计，而委托代码的完全访问权是默认效果。对普通用户，这意味着“签一次授权”的后果可能远超一次交易；对交易所，热钱包一旦签名环节失守，单点损失规模会被放大。

据此推断，后续值得跟踪三点：钱包是否默认限制或隐藏EIP-7702委托入口；交易所热钱包是否迁移至多签或限额账户；是否有提案收紧委托权限。若这些约束落地，上述判断的紧迫性会下降；若本次素材未提供相关进展，则只能视为待验证问题，而非已发生事实。本文不构成投资建议。

title: 交易心理 | 比预测行情更重要的事：复盘你自己的单子
subTitle:
大部分人花90%的时间预测行情，花0%的时间复盘自己。方向反了。

每笔单子记三行字：为什么开（依据是什么）、哪里错/对（执行层面）、
下次怎么改（具体动作）。坚持一个月，你会震惊地发现：你亏损的
单子里有大量「同一类错误」在反复出现——比如总是止损后立刻反手、
总是盈利单拿不住。

行情会变，但你的行为模式不会自动变，除非你盯着它改。市场是最
诚实的老师，你的交割单就是成绩单。别只看账户余额，去翻交易记录。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#交易心理 #复盘 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your reasoning), what went right or wrong (execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover: your losses
Your trade log is full of the same mistakes repeated over and over—for example, immediately reversing direction after a stop-loss,
or always cutting winning trades short.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every bit of wisdom. So I wrote these rules down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
5. Withdraw part of your profits. The money you take out is money; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

Just five rules, and not one is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution gets distorted. Let’s keep each other accountable.

Trading approach
